0022600193.text: Orlando (2-6, 0-4 at home, three straight losses, 5th in the Southeast and 12th in the East) visits Golden State (6-3, winners of six straight, 2nd in the Pacific and 7th in the West) with the two teams yet to meet in 2026-27. Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (out, ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (out, knee), Jonathan Isaac (out, knee), Noah Penda (out, hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (out, ankle sprain), while Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (out, knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (out, illness), and Moses Moody (out, knee surgery), and Draymond Green (elbow inflammation), Gary Payton II (calf), and Gui Santos (knee) are listed as day-to-day. The teams split the 2025-26 season series 1-1, and the Magic's last meeting was a 120-97 loss in San Francisco on December 22, 2025.
